item.guhs.churros.lore: Linguhs get queasy from these. Nobody knows why.
item.guhs.churros_guhtella.lore: One more thing that makes Linguhs queasy. Doubly tasty then, njeg.
item.guhs.suikerspin.lore: A little cloud of sugar on a stick. Sticks to your guh moustache.
item.guhs.poffertjes.lore: A tray full, under a mountain of powdered sugar. Vahoeg!
item.guhs.oliebollen.lore: Round, warm and vadsig. Just like a guh.
advancements.guhs.quest.kermiskraam_gesp: Play a game at a stall of the Guh Kermis
advancements.guhs.quest.kermiskraam_alle: Get the top score at all three game stalls
gui.guhs.kermiskraam.churros.hallo: Njeg! Churros for 15 nibbles, with Guhtella for 18. Fresh vads!
gui.guhs.kermiskraam.suikerspin.hallo: Candy floss! Eight nibbles for a little cloud. Vahoeg sweet!
gui.guhs.kermiskraam.poffertjes.hallo: A tray of poffertjes for 10 nibbles? Powdered sugar is free, njeg!
gui.guhs.kermiskraam.oliebollen.hallo: Oliebollen! 12 nibbles, and yes, you may have them all year.
gui.guhs.kermiskraam.vissen.uitleg: Click when a guhtje floats under the hook
gui.guhs.kermiskraam.blikken.uitleg: Click when the marker is in the green
gui.guhs.kermiskraam.schieten.uitleg: Click the nibbles before they are gone
gui.guhs.kermiskraam.wacht: The stall guh is setting up. %s more seconds, vadsje!
gui.guhs.kermiskraam.prijs.troost: A consolation nibble, because you tried so sweetly.
